findings.text: Foreign mapping cleanup helper reports success unconditionally for the routed configuration and does not alter its unmap, kunmap, page or count inputs.
Two small helpers provide fault tolerant access to one machine word, with the store reporting a status and the load reporting a status while preserving a defined sentinel when the access faults.

Guest frame to machine frame translation is identity outside PV mode and inside PV mode resolves through cached state with defined fallbacks for large and invalid inputs, hiding foreign and identity marker bits from callers.

Machine frame to guest frame translation treats out of range as unknown, validates the reverse association, and falls back to identity for marked entries, with mapping validity defined by absence of the invalid sentinel.

Physical to machine and machine to physical address converters preserve page offset and delegate frame conversion to the frame helpers, with guest frame names and buffer frame names treated as aliases.

Virtual address converters derive a frame number then reuse the frame translators to reach machine, guest and local views, with local conversion signalling mismatch by a value that fails validity tests.
Direct indexing of the machine to physical table can fault on sparse or device regions, so lookup uses guarded loading and maps faults to an unknown mapping sentinel instead of crashing.
Page table value helpers expose raw entry contents unchanged across PTE, PMD, PUD and P4D levels and convert between frame numbers and entries by page shift and architecture mask handling.
Architecture SWIOTLB need check for Xen always reports no bounce buffering required in this header.
Frame and address translation helpers serve as inline entry points for Xen aware memory management shared by PV and non PV paths.
PCI frontend operations table provides four callback slots covering MSI enable and MSI disable plus MSI-X enable and MSI-X disable, each operating on a PCI device with vector storage.
PCI frontend wrappers forward to installed callbacks when present, otherwise enable paths report unsupported and disable paths do nothing.
PCI Xen presence has enabled and disabled build variants, with disabled builds defining init as zero and both HVM init and initial domain probes reporting failure.
Headers use once only inclusion guards to prevent multiple inclusion.

Multicall batch tracing defines flush causes for explicit flush plus batch space, argument space and callback space exhaustion, plus extension outcomes for success, bad operation and no space, with a generic pointer callback type.

Legacy executable header carries an info word plus separate text, data, bss, symbol table, entry and text relocation plus data relocation sizes, with accessors for text relocation, data relocation and symbol sizes.

HSMP request carries a numeric identifier plus input count plus expected output count plus fixed argument buffer plus socket index, while each descriptor entry pairs argument and response counts with a direction value.
HSMP message payload capacity is eight words.
HSMP protocol versions form a consecutive sequence covering second through seventh generations.
HSMP identifier space spans power, frequency, thermal, bandwidth, link width, P-state, C-state, RAPL and sideband operations with reserved gaps and a terminal maximum marker.
HSMP direction distinguishes reserved from set only, get only and combined set get exchanges, determining whether argument words are consumed, produced or both.

HSMP descriptor table assigns per identifier input and output word counts with units including milliwatts, megahertz, residency, temperature, power limits and bandwidth encodings for the visible prefix.
